name: const unsafe fn from_ptr < 'a > (ptr : * mut * mut T) -> & 'a AtomicPtr < T >
rule: Accesses to the memory referenced by the returned `AtomicPtr<T>` must not cause data races: overlapping accesses where at least one is a write and at least one is non-atomic must be synchronized so that one happens-before the other. An unsuccessful `compare_exchange` or `compare_exchange_weak` is not considered a write.
